title: hieracium maculatum subsp. lecokianum
intro: Hieracium maculatum subsp. lecokianum, commonly known as Lecok's Hawkweed, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lecok's Hawkweed may include wound healing, skin protection, and immune system support, thanks to its bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to confirm the full range of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
